title: Create: Data Centers
description: Harness the computational power of Ae2 256k cells to earn money.
body:
Adds compatibility using AE2 256k cells to generate credits in a datacenter, which is used to trade for resources. Also allows you to trade for Create: Numismatics currency.

features:
Data Center, when powered with FE and supplied with water, harnesses the computational power of the 256k storage cell from Ae2. This provides you with credits tied to the player, which can be exchanged in the data center block or automatically via the Auto exchanger for raw materials or Create: Numismatics currency.

Auto Exchanger, uses your credits to automatically exchange them for items. You must put the desired item in the filter. It will automatically exchange them, and at the same prices in the data center block, great for farms.

Configs, pretty much all features in this mod are configurable, perfect for server owners, balanced economies, or challenges.
